_note: Content layer for v0.6. Numbers live in v06_settings.json; this file holds text, town hints and moods. {good}, {port}, {n} are filled at runtime.

marketEvents.headline: Shortage of {good}!
marketEvents.text: The stalls of {port} stand bare. Merchants whisper about {good}, and pay double to anyone who has it.

marketEvents.headline: {good} piled on the docks
marketEvents.text: Three ships arrived at once. {port} is drowning in {good}, and nobody wants to buy.

marketEvents.headline: Festival in {port}
marketEvents.text: Lanterns in every window. The wealthy want silk, pearls and incense, and they won't haggle tonight.

marketEvents.headline: {port} closes its gates to {good}
marketEvents.text: Soldiers on the quay. Bring {good} here and it will be seized, whatever your papers say.

marketEvents.headline: A foreign ship in the harbor
marketEvents.text: Strange sails, strange sailors, and in their hold, {good}. They leave on the next tide.

marketEvents.headline: The Sultan's wedding
marketEvents.text: The Sultan marries next moon. Every perfumer, weaver and pearl diver in {port} has doubled their prices, and so should you.

rumors.text: A drunk customs clerk swears {port} will ban {good} next moon.
Sailors from {port} say the {good} harvest failed. Someone will get rich.
Don't take {good} to {port}. Half the coast had the same idea.
Black sails seen off {port}. Rich holds make tempting targets.
The stars warn of a storm on the road to {port}. Sail slow, or sail brave.
A scorched seal crosses your path near {port}. Qarin's agents are close.
The charm caravan turns toward {port} with the new moon.

ambushCards.warning: The fog is too thick, and too quiet.
ambushCards.reveal: Black sails loom out of the mist, close enough to hear their oars!

ambushCards.warning: A wreck flying a distress flag drifts ahead.
ambushCards.reveal: The 'survivors' draw blades. It was bait!

ambushCards.warning: Lanterns where no lanterns should be.
ambushCards.reveal: Small boats close in under the dark, then the muzzle flashes begin!

intimidated: Their spyglass catches your guns. The black flag drops, and they turn and run.
